result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small business, I'd narrow it down to three options: **1Password, Bitwarden and Keeper**\.

## Best password managers for small teams

![Wachtwoordmanager 1Password | KPN](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SR9cQiLQIFEFCALVJ5nUtWe25Q29qJVc5LjX65WdCnj5yzmD0dY1kGYKRcHN2028gLjEDLJ1Kkz4elZpmKF_3nFRDEJ56EPcrV1LwREU1riSDOE2qPsulZBrm1uLMFbZk3uGppXxaiJ5LZXh3ClEqc5wBJ1jJuMVahqzv5wwpeyD20eaUwi0i3WuDMRbtYuK?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

- Excellent user experience across desktop and mobile.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Easy employee onboarding and offboarding.
- Security alerts and admin controls.

**Indicative price\:** US\$24.95/month for up to 10 users (Starter Pack).

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source software.
- Strong team sharing and organisation collections.
- Admin controls and event logs.
- Good for technically minded teams.

**Indicative price\:** US\$4/user/month for Teams, annually.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

- Good administrative controls.
- Shared folders and team permissions.
- Strong security and compliance features.
- Worth considering for businesses with stricter security requirements.

**Indicative price\:** From US\$2/user/month for Business Starter.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

Prices are indicative USD pricing based on published 2026 plans, before tax. Check current Australian pricing at checkout. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[cybercred.com.au](https://cybercred.com.au/articles/password-managers-compared-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd choose **1Password** for most small businesses.

The biggest benefit isn't simply storing passwords. It's being able to\:

- Share company logins without revealing passwords individually.
- Give employees access only to the accounts they need.
- Revoke access immediately when someone leaves.
- Keep business credentials separate from personal credentials.
- Store secure notes, Wi-Fi credentials, software licences and other sensitive information.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I can give you a much more specific recommendation if I know\:

**1\. How many people are in your team?**

2–5

5–10

10–25

25–50

---

**2\. What does your business primarily use?**

Microsoft 365

Google Workspace

Apple / Mac

A mixture of platforms

---

**3\. What's most important?**

Ease of use and security

Lowest possible cost

Maximum security and admin controls

Australian data hosting and compliance

---

**4\. What do you need to share?**

Website and software logins

Wi-Fi, server and infrastructure credentials

Both

[Get my recommendation]
